## Project Summary

TI Mindmap HUB automates the processing of OSINT threat intelligence reports
using Large Language Models. It produces structured outputs including interactive
mindmaps, STIX 2.1 bundles, IOC extraction, CVE intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK
mapping, weekly threat briefings generated by a multi-agent AI system, and a
cross-report knowledge graph (STIX Constellation).
The platform exposes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with 27 tools for
AI assistant integration (VS Code + GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT,
Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Cursor, Claude Code).
Most of the web app requires a free account; Agentic Reports (/analytics)
are public.
